details:
- CVE-2022-0934: Fix write-after-free in DHCPv6 relay handling that
  could be triggered by a crafted packet, leading to denial of service
- rfc3315: fix bad reply to DHCPCONFIRM messages (wrong message type)
- rfc3315: fix integer underflow and heap overflow in log6_opts
  STATUS_CODE
- rfc3315: fix DHCPv6 "use multicast" response which previously failed
